Reservation terms

iNotes

• The above prices are in EUR per unit/ per night with HB included.
• Child 0-1.99 years - free of charge
• Children of 11,99 years old and more are considered as adults.
• Minimum stay of 5 nights in the period 01.07 - 29.08., 4 nights in the period 16.06 - 30.06., 3 nights in other periods.
• Note: Tourist tax (5€ per day/per room) not included in regular prices.
• Deposit of 30% of the total price of the reservation is required to confirm a booking. The remaining balance will be paid 15 days before the arrival.

Cancelation policy
• If a reservation is canceled up to 15 days before the date of arrival, the deposit will be 100% refunded, minus administrative fee which in most cases is 30€ but it could be more.
• If canceled 14-10 days before arrival, 50% of the paid amount will be applied.
• If canceled 9-4 days before arrival 70% charge will be applied.
• If canceled 3-1 days before arrival 90% charge will be applied.
• In case of a no show, 100% charge will be applied.

Accommodation description

Offering an outdoor pool with a sun terrace, Golden Beach Hotel is located in Metamorfosi. Free WiFi access is available in all areas.

Accommodation

Each air-conditioned room here will provide you with a satellite, flat-screen TV.

Show full description Hide the rest

There is also a refrigerator and a private bathroom with a shower.

At Golden Beach Hotel you will find a front desk and a bar. Other facilities offered at the property include luggage storage and a children's playground.

Thessaloniki Airport is 63 km away. Free public parking is possible nearby.

Available TV channels in local and foreign languages. Cleaning every day, Towels and Linen changing every third day (after third night).

The service is on the HB basis. If some of the clients are vegetarians or Muslim please make a NOTE in the arrival list. 

Services & Facilities

• Air conditioning
• Reception, Bar, Restaurant, Safety deposit box, Lift, Airport shuttle (additional charge)
• Bathroom
• Hair dryer (available upon request, at reception)
• Fridge
• TV with satellite channels, Wi-Fi internet
• Garden, Terrace, Swimming pool, Playground
• Free sunbeds & umbrellas at the pool
• Public parking
• Cleaning every day
• Towels & linen change every third day
• Baby cot for free (due to a limited number, a prior reservation is required)

Location and nearby beaches

Metamorfosi, Sithonia

Metamorfosi is a peaceful village on the northern side of Sithonia, known for its pine forests, fresh air, and calm coastal atmosphere. The shoreline here has small sandy and pebbly beaches with clear, warm water that is comfortable for swimming. Accommodation includes family-run apartments, small hotels, and holiday homes surrounded by greenery, which gives the village a relaxing, natural feel. Metamorfosi is not a crowded resort, so the pace is slow and suitable for families and travelers who want a restful holiday. The village has taverns, cafés, and a few shops for everyday needs, while larger centers like Nikiti are just a short drive away. Pine trees provide natural shade along parts of the coast, making beach time pleasant even on hotter days. With its quiet environment and convenient location, Metamorfosi is a good base for exploring the beaches of northern Sithonia.
